copy.tagline: 先写测试再写代码，驱动开发流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果习惯先写测试再实现功能
copy.tagline_en: Write tests before code to drive development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer writing tests before implementation

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会强制先写测试再写代码。它要求你为每个新功能或修复先写一个会失败的测试，然后写最少代码让测试通过，最后清理代码。整个过程必须看到测试先失败再通过。
howto.when: 当你要求添加新功能、修复 bug、重构代码或改变行为时触发。如果你试图先写代码再写测试，Claude 会要求你删除代码并重新开始。

say.text: 帮我用 TDD 方式写一个重试函数，最多重试3次。
say.note: Claude 会先写一个会失败的测试，然后写代码让它通过。

say.text: 修复这个 bug，但必须先用测试复现它。
say.note: Claude 会先写一个暴露 bug 的测试，再修复代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude enforces writing tests before implementation code. It requires you to write a failing test for each new feature or fix, then write the minimum code to pass it, and finally refactor. The entire process must observe the test fail first and then pass.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a new feature, fix a bug, refactor, or change behavior. If you try to write code before tests, Claude will ask you to delete the code and start over.

say_en.text: Help me write a retry function using TDD, with max 3 retries.
say_en.note: Claude will first write a failing test, then code to pass it.

say_en.text: Fix this bug, but first write a failing test that reproduces it.
say_en.note: Claude will write a test exposing the bug, then fix the code.
